category_title: Disengaged EMLLs with antsy behavior and coping through imitation
scenario_title: Physical acting out with a substitute teacher
minimal_context: Shen is in the classroom with a substitute teacher who is trying to start the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to start our lesson. Please sit in your seat.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets up out of his seat and walks around the classroom without permission, appearing antsy.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to go back to your seat.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to walk around the classroom without permission and picks up a bag.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are you doing with that bag?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Swings the bag around in a circle and hits the substitute teacher with it.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to start our lesson. Please sit in your seat.

STUDENT: (Gets up out of his seat and walks around the classroom without permission, appearing antsy.)

TUTOR: You need to go back to your seat.

STUDENT: (Continues to walk around the classroom without permission and picks up a bag.)

TUTOR: What are you doing with that bag?

STUDENT: (Swings the bag around in a circle and hits the substitute teacher with it.)
